title: Player checks out at the kiosk
description: When leaving the club, a present member finds their name (by typing), opens Check-out, enters their PIN, and leaves today’s attendance.

steps.title: Check-in kiosk
steps.body: The same kiosk mode handles leaving: members who are present see Check-out on their row.

steps.title: Find your name
steps.body: You can scroll the roster to find Alex Rivera, but it is more efficient to start typing in the name search.
steps.actionHint: Type in the name search field

steps.title: Your row appears
steps.body: Typing part of the name narrows the list. Alex Rivera is already checked in for today, so their row shows Check-out.
steps.resultNote: Name filter matches the member; Check-out is ready.

steps.title: Start check-out
steps.body: Tap Check-out on your row. The kiosk asks for the same score PIN used at check-in.

steps.title: Enter PIN and confirm
steps.body: Type the PIN, then confirm Check-out. A correct PIN ends the open visit for today.
steps.actionHint: Click Check-out after entering the PIN

steps.title: State updated
steps.body: The row has changed: Check-out is gone and Check-in returns (free re-entry if they come back today). The attendance count drops.
steps.resultNote: Member is no longer present; kiosk row offers Check-in again.
